Vision Zero View

The Vision Zero Crash & Interventions Map is an interactive tool that shows detailed monthly information on traffic injury and fatality crashes in New York City and highlights how the city is responding every day to make our streets safer. The map displays crash types, dates and locations and highlights Vision Zero initiatives such as leading pedestrian intervals, planning workshops and expanded traffic enforcement, major safety projects, as well as other long running safety programs.
